items.title: Helen Haines updates: PM says person in custody after alleged attack on Helen Haines
items.standfirst: Independent MP Helen Haines has been injured in an incident involving a vehicle outside her electorate office in Wangaratta, in regional Victoria. Follow updatesAlbanese says his thoughts and his prayers are with Haines, her family and her community.Helen Haines is incredibly hardworking. She is fiercely intelligent, but most importantly, she’s just thoroughly decent human being, full of integrity and respected right across the parliament, and from everyone who comes into contact with her, she is a well-loved member of her community, and this will come as an incredible shock to that community.Our thoughts remain with Helen Haines at this very difficult time.The year before last, we had 951 reports of harassing and threatening behaviour against various high office holders. The more recent financial year, that 951 has gone to 1,067.There is a major police investigation underway, and I can confirm that a suspect is in custody.The Australian Federal Police, Victorian Police, and Asio are working together on this. The joint counter-terrorism team has been activated, but the motive is not known. Continue reading...
